y1: One Sabbath Jesus and His disciples were walking through the grain fields. His hungry disciples began to pick heads of grain and eat them.
y2: The Pharisees got angry and said, “You can't work on the Sabbath!” Jesus said, “God wants mercy, not sacrifice. I am the Lord of the Sabbath.”
y3: The man with a shriveled hand
y4: In the synagogue, there was a man with a shriveled hand that couldn't move. The people watched to see if Jesus would heal on the Sabbath.
y5: Jesus said, “If your sheep falls into a pit on the Sabbath, wouldn't you lift it out? A person is much more valuable than a sheep.” “Stretch out your hand!” The man's hand was completely healed.
y6: He won't break a bruised reed
y7: Jesus didn't shout loudly or argue. He quietly healed the sick.
y8: The Bible says about Jesus: “He won't break a bruised reed, and He won't put out a smoldering wick.” He cares for weak people with kindness.
y10: Jesus's mother and brothers came to see Him. Jesus pointed to His disciples and said:
y11: “Whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother, sister, and mother.” If we do God's will, we are Jesus's family.
verse: “Whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother, sister, and mother.”
prayer: Jesus, thank You for giving the Sabbath as a gift of rest and for healing the sick on that day. Thank You for caring for me and not breaking me when I am like a bruised reed. Help me to do God's will and be Your family. I pray in Jesus Christ's name. Amen.
d0: Sabbath. It is a day to stop working and rest in God once a week. God gave the Sabbath as a gift.
d1: sacrifice. It was a way of worshiping God by offering animals or grain. God wants mercy more than sacrifice.
d2: mercy. It is a heart that feels sorry for others and helps them. Jesus showed mercy to His hungry disciples.
d3: reed. It is a thin and weak plant that grows by the water. Jesus doesn't even break a bruised reed.
d4: will. It is what God wants. We do God's will.
d5: family. They are people who love each other and live together. Those who do God's will are Jesus's family.
